2023-1.title: Building and Planning Legislation Amendment Act 2023
2023-1.summary: Provides for recognition of certain interstate occupational registrations in building, plumbing, architecture and surveying, and amends planning rules protecting green wedges and distinctive landscapes.

2023-2.title: Racing Amendment (Unauthorised Access) Act 2023
2023-2.summary: Prohibits unauthorised entry to restricted areas of racecourses and certain disruptive conduct during race meetings and official trials.

2023-3.title: Local Government (Moira Shire Council) Act 2023
2023-3.summary: Dismisses Moira Shire Council, provides for interim administrators and sets arrangements for a further council election.

2023-4.title: Health Legislation Amendment (Information Sharing) Act 2023
2023-4.summary: Creates a central electronic system for public hospitals and other specified health services to share patient information for treatment.

2023-5.title: Heritage Amendment Act 2023
2023-5.summary: Changes heritage notice, document access and hearing procedures and provides for determinations excluding places or objects from registration consideration.

2023-6.title: Statute Law Amendment Act 2023
2023-6.summary: Makes technical corrections across Victorian statutes, including minor amendments to competition policy legislation.

2023-7.title: Drugs, Poisons and Controlled Substances Amendment (Medically Supervised Injecting Centre) Act 2023
2023-7.summary: Enables the licensed medically supervised injecting centre to continue beyond the trial period, with repeatable licence renewals and only one licence in force at a time.

2023-8.title: Human Source Management Act 2023
2023-8.summary: Sets rules for Victoria Police to register, use and manage confidential human sources and provides for external oversight.

2023-9.title: Disability and Social Services Regulation Amendment Act 2023
2023-9.summary: Revises disability service registration, information sharing, accommodation and compulsory treatment rules, and changes oversight powers for social services.

2023-10.title: Water Legislation Amendment Act 2023
2023-10.summary: Extends the deadline for earlier water reforms to commence and refines rules governing when, where and at what rate water may be taken.

2023-11.title: Building Legislation Amendment Act 2023
2023-11.summary: Provides for a State Building Surveyor and Building Monitor and changes practitioner categories, building permit information and building manual requirements.

2023-12.title: Energy Legislation Amendment (Electricity Outage Emergency Response and Other Matters) Act 2023
2023-12.summary: Allows government directions to electricity distributors during specified outage emergencies and changes fees and enforcement under the Victorian Energy Upgrades scheme.

2023-13.title: Gambling Regulation Amendment Act 2023
2023-13.summary: Revises rules for wagering and betting, including operator licensing, betting exchanges, licence conditions and complaint investigations.

2023-14.title: Gambling Taxation Act 2023
2023-14.summary: Consolidates and amends Victorian gambling taxes and makes related changes to casino, gambling and tax administration laws.

2023-15.title: Appropriation (2023-2024) Act 2023
2023-15.summary: Authorises spending from the Consolidated Fund for ordinary Victorian Government services in 2023–24.

2023-16.title: Appropriation (Parliament 2023-2024) Act 2023
2023-16.summary: Authorises spending from the Consolidated Fund for the Parliament of Victoria in 2023–24.

2023-17.title: Children and Health Legislation Amendment (Statement of Recognition, Aboriginal Self-determination and Other Matters) Act 2023
2023-17.summary: Recognises Aboriginal self-determination in child protection, expands placement principles and changes the powers of authorised Aboriginal agencies and judicial registrars.

2023-18.title: State Taxation Acts Amendment Act 2023
2023-18.summary: Changes state duties and taxes, including disability and concession relief, treatment of collective investment vehicles and the phase-out of business insurance duty.

2023-19.title: Victorian Future Fund Act 2023
2023-19.summary: Establishes the Victorian Future Fund to help reduce state debt and sets rules for its administration, payments, reporting and audit.

2023-20.title: Mental Health and Wellbeing Amendment Act 2023
2023-20.summary: Makes minor changes to the Mental Health and Wellbeing Act 2022 and consequential changes to the law on reporting judicial proceedings.

2023-21.title: Drugs, Poisons and Controlled Substances Amendment (Authorising Pharmacists) Act 2023
2023-21.summary: Allows regulations authorising pharmacists to supply or administer specified prescription medicines without a prescription in defined circumstances.

2023-22.title: Energy Legislation Amendment (Energy Safety) Act 2023
2023-22.summary: Updates electricity safety duties, bushfire mitigation and safety management plans, incident preservation and enforcement powers.

2023-23.title: Mineral Resources (Sustainable Development) Amendment Act 2023
2023-23.summary: Replaces some mining and quarrying work-plan requirements with risk-based duties to prevent harm, while retaining and updating rehabilitation planning.

2023-24.title: Energy Legislation Amendment Act 2023
2023-24.summary: Sets decision criteria for Victoria’s electricity reliability intervention and enables civil penalties for certain breaches of gas system rules.

2023-25.title: Statute Law Amendment (References to the Sovereign) Act 2023
2023-25.summary: Updates how Victorian statutes refer to the Sovereign following the death of Queen Elizabeth II.

2023-26.title: Justice Legislation Amendment Act 2023
2023-26.summary: Makes alternative forms of public access to proceedings and court health safeguards permanent, and changes coronial investigation, information-sharing and firefighter compensation rules.

2023-27.title: Summary Offences Amendment (Nazi Salute Prohibition) Act 2023
2023-27.summary: Creates an offence for publicly displaying or performing Nazi gestures and extends the offence concerning public display of Nazi symbols.

2023-28.title: Bail Amendment Act 2023
2023-28.summary: Changes bail tests and the considerations for children and Aboriginal people, and repeals two offences related to being on bail.

2023-29.title: Education and Training Reform Amendment (Land Powers) Act 2023
2023-29.summary: Expands powers to acquire, use and develop land for early childhood education, care and related services.

2023-30.title: Gambling Legislation Amendment Act 2023
2023-30.summary: Changes casino management, winnings and pre-commitment rules, restricts gaming venue hours and extends certain wagering restrictions to interstate providers.

2023-31.title: Special Investigator Repeal Act 2023
2023-31.summary: Repeals the Special Investigator Act, abolishes the Office of the Special Investigator and sets transitional arrangements while preserving specified offences.

2023-32.title: Triple Zero Victoria Act 2023
2023-32.summary: Establishes Triple Zero Victoria to replace the Emergency Services Telecommunications Authority.

2023-33.title: Early Childhood Legislation Amendment (Premises Approval in Principle) Act 2023
2023-33.summary: Provides for approval in principle of certain proposed childcare premises and allows it to be required before service approval.

2023-34.title: Transport Legislation Amendment Act 2023
2023-34.summary: Aligns commercial bus driver accreditation with other passenger transport accreditation and revises decision review, information-sharing and transport infrastructure consultation rules.

2023-35.title: Environment Legislation Amendment (Circular Economy and Other Matters) Act 2023
2023-35.summary: Refines the container deposit and waste-to-energy schemes, including cost recovery, and updates environmental protection law.

2023-36.title: Corrections Amendment (Parole Reform) Act 2023
2023-36.summary: Restricts parole for Paul Denyer and changes how the Adult Parole Board can set periods of parole ineligibility.

2023-37.title: Crimes Amendment (Non-fatal Strangulation) Act 2023
2023-37.summary: Creates two offences of non-fatal strangulation and makes a related amendment to family violence law.

2023-38.title: State Taxation Acts and Other Acts Amendment Act 2023
2023-38.summary: Changes state tax rules on land sub-sales, concession and corporate reconstruction duties, land valuation, first-home grants and certain property tax adjustments.

2024-1.title: Biosecurity Legislation Amendment (Incident Response) Act 2024
2024-1.summary: Expands biosecurity information sharing, emergency controls, compensation and enforcement for livestock disease outbreaks.

2024-2.title: Justice Legislation Amendment (Police and Other Matters) Act 2024
2024-2.summary: Changes working-with-children check exemptions, firearms surrender and licensing, vehicle immobilisation powers and arrangements between fire services.

2024-3.title: Land (Revocation of Reservations) Act 2024
2024-3.summary: Revokes or changes Crown land reservations at specified sites, including Victoria Park Lake, Toolangi, Seaspray and former Mechanics Institute properties.

2024-4.title: Building Legislation Amendment (Domestic Building Insurance New Offences) Act 2024
2024-4.summary: Makes it an offence for builders to demand or receive payments under major domestic building contracts without the required insurance and gives the building regulator enforcement powers.

2024-5.title: Service Victoria Amendment Act 2024
2024-5.summary: Allows Service Victoria to deliver services with or for non-government bodies and expands its functions and digital identity verification powers.

2024-6.title: Regulatory Legislation Amendment (Reform) Act 2024
2024-6.summary: Updates regulatory and enforcement provisions across several laws, including fee units, essential services, meat and seafood regulation, and food safety.

2024-7.title: Education and Training Reform Amendment (Early Childhood Employment Powers) Act 2024
2024-7.summary: Allows the education department to hire staff for government early learning centres, sets employment entitlements and enables fees for those centres.

2024-8.title: Workplace Injury Rehabilitation and Compensation Amendment (WorkCover Scheme Modernisation) Act 2024
2024-8.summary: Changes eligibility for WorkCover mental injury benefits and introduces an impairment threshold for weekly payments beyond 130 weeks.

2024-9.title: Climate Change and Energy Legislation Amendment (Renewable Energy and Storage Targets) Act 2024
2024-9.summary: Moves Victoria’s net zero target to 2045, raises the 2030 renewable electricity target to 65%, and sets further renewable energy and storage targets.

2024-10.title: Firearms and Control of Weapons (Machetes) Amendment Act 2024
2024-10.summary: Changes how firearm prohibition orders are served and clarifies that machetes are classified as knives under weapons law.

2024-11.title: State Electricity Commission Amendment Act 2024
2024-11.summary: Abolishes the former statutory State Electricity Commission of Victoria and transfers its remaining functions, property, rights and liabilities to the Minister or State.

2024-12.title: Private Security and County Court Amendment Act 2024
2024-12.summary: Overhauls private security licensing and complaints, introduces subcontracting offences and risk management requirements, and amends County Court legislation.

2024-13.title: Statute Law Revision Act 2024
2024-13.summary: Makes technical revisions and corrections across Victorian statutes.

2024-14.title: Energy and Public Land Legislation Amendment (Enabling Offshore Wind Energy) Act 2024
2024-14.summary: Allows longer Crown land licences to assess offshore transmission projects and changes national park arrangements to support offshore wind infrastructure.

2024-15.title: National Electricity (Victoria) Amendment (VicGrid) Act 2024
2024-15.summary: Establishes VicGrid’s chief executive and transmission planning functions, provides for renewable energy zones and enables payments to affected landholders.

2024-16.title: Commercial and Industrial Property Tax Reform Act 2024
2024-16.summary: Introduces an annual commercial and industrial property tax and provides for eligible properties to transition from transfer duty into the new scheme.

2024-17.title: Estate Agents, Residential Tenancies and Other Acts Amendment (Funding) Act 2024
2024-17.summary: Changes funding for estate agent and tenancy dispute resolution and advocacy, abolishes the Estate Agents Council and facilitates closure of the Sex Work Regulation Fund.

2024-18.title: National Energy Retail Law (Victoria) Act 2024
2024-18.summary: Applies national retailer-of-last-resort rules in Victoria so electricity and gas customers can be transferred when a retailer fails.

2024-19.title: Appropriation (2024-2025) Act 2024
2024-19.summary: Authorises spending from the Consolidated Fund for ordinary Victorian Government services in 2024–25.

2024-20.title: Appropriation (Parliament 2024-2025) Act 2024
2024-20.summary: Authorises spending from the Consolidated Fund for the Parliament of Victoria in 2024–25.

2024-21.title: Financial Management Amendment (Gender Responsive Budgeting) Act 2024
2024-21.summary: Requires gender equality and inclusion to be considered in fiscal policy and provides for an annual statement on the budget’s gender impacts.

2024-22.title: State Taxation Amendment Act 2024
2024-22.summary: Changes business insurance duty, casino tax reporting, payroll tax and land tax rules, including exemptions for specified housing and holiday homes.

2024-23.title: Local Government Amendment (Governance and Integrity) Act 2024
2024-23.summary: Requires ongoing mayoral and councillor training, strengthens council conduct rules and expands suspension, disqualification and inspector powers.

2024-24.title: Sustainable Forests (Timber) Repeal Act 2024
2024-24.summary: Repeals the law governing commercial native forest timber harvesting, abolishes VicForests and transfers its property, rights and liabilities to the Crown.

2024-25.title: Victorian Responsible Gambling Foundation Repeal and Advisory Councils Act 2024
2024-25.summary: Abolishes the Victorian Responsible Gambling Foundation, creates the Gambling Harm Response Fund and changes gambling advisory and regulatory arrangements.

2024-26.title: Confiscation Amendment (Unexplained Wealth) Act 2024
2024-26.summary: Expands the unexplained wealth regime by enabling court orders for debts to the State and forfeiture of property that cannot be shown to come from lawful sources.

2024-27.title: Parliamentary Workplace Standards and Integrity Act 2024
2024-27.summary: Establishes the Parliamentary Workplace Standards and Integrity Commission, Parliamentary Integrity Adviser and Parliamentary Ethics Committee.

2024-28.title: State Sporting Legislation Amendment Act 2024
2024-28.summary: Changes the scope of Anzac Day sport rules and updates governance and event management arrangements for Kardinia Park and Melbourne and Olympic Parks.

2024-29.title: Aboriginal Land Legislation Amendment Act 2024
2024-29.summary: Updates Aboriginal land trust governance, membership and share transfers, financial reporting, and provisions for specified Aboriginal land.

2024-30.title: Prahran Mechanics' Institute Repeal Act 2024
2024-30.summary: Dissolves the statutory Prahran Mechanics’ Institution and Circulating Library and transfers its property, rights and liabilities to PMI Victorian History Library Inc.

2024-31.title: Justice Legislation Amendment (Integrity, Defamation and Other Matters) Act 2024
2024-31.summary: Changes defamation rules for third-party online content and absolute privilege, and updates access to court data and the use of electronic signatures in criminal proceedings.

2024-32.title: Youth Justice Act 2024
2024-32.summary: Raises the minimum age of criminal responsibility to 12 and sets a statutory framework for youth justice, including Children’s Court procedures and oversight.

2024-33.title: Residential Tenancies and Funerals Amendment Act 2024
2024-33.summary: Revises disclosure and rent increase rules for residential park site agreements and requires funeral providers to publish price lists online and at their premises.

2024-34.title: Victorian Institute of Forensic Medicine Act 2024
2024-34.summary: Re-establishes the Victorian Institute of Forensic Medicine under updated legislation and repeals its 1985 Act.

2024-35.title: State Civil Liability (Police Informants) Act 2024
2024-35.summary: Caps the total civil compensation payable by the State for claims relating to information or assistance from specified police informants.

2024-36.title: Constitution Amendment (SEC) Act 2024
2024-36.summary: Requires the State to retain a controlling interest in the SEC, sets its statutory objectives and restricts changes to those constitutional protections.

2024-37.title: Criminal Organisations Control Amendment Act 2024
2024-37.summary: Reforms unlawful association rules, adds independent oversight and serious crime prevention orders, and prohibits public display of insignia of specified organisations.

2024-38.title: Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Trust Amendment Act 2024
2024-38.summary: Renames the Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Trust, expands its functions and updates its membership and governance arrangements.

2024-39.title: Health Legislation Amendment (Regulatory Reform) Act 2024
2024-39.summary: Abolishes the Victorian Assisted Reproductive Treatment Authority, transfers regulatory and donor information duties and changes requirements for donor material and access to records.

2024-40.title: Short Stay Levy Act 2024
2024-40.summary: Introduces a levy on short-stay accommodation and enables owners corporations to prohibit certain short-stay use.

2024-41.title: Drugs, Poisons and Controlled Substances Amendment (Pill Testing) Act 2024
2024-41.summary: Provides for drug-checking services and permits automatic dispensing machines to supply certain medicines used to treat opioid overdose.

2024-42.title: Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Amendment Act 2024
2024-42.summary: Changes offshore petroleum production licensing, including licensee rights, access to infrastructure and monitoring powers.

2024-43.title: Building Legislation Amendment and Other Matters Act 2024
2024-43.summary: Updates building notices and orders, access to adjoining owner details for protection work and time limits for certain building and plumbing actions.

2024-44.title: Agriculture and Food Safety Legislation Amendment Act 2024
2024-44.summary: Creates offences concerning the sale and supply of raw milk and updates food safety enforcement and information display requirements.

2024-45.title: Duties Amendment (More Homes) Act 2024
2024-45.summary: Introduces temporary transfer duty relief for newly constructed dwellings in strata developments.

2024-46.title: Roads and Road Safety Legislation Amendment Act 2024
2024-46.summary: Allows camera enforcement of no-truck zones and changes registration number transfers, accessible parking terminology and refunds of fees attached to fines.

2024-47.title: Subordinate Legislation and Administrative Arrangements Amendment Act 2024
2024-47.summary: Updates the laws governing subordinate legislation, fee units and administrative arrangements.

2024-48.title: Transport Infrastructure and Planning Legislation Amendment Act 2024
2024-48.summary: Expands declaration, delegation and delivery powers for major transport projects and applies those powers to specified precinct projects.

2024-49.title: Aged Care Restrictive Practices Substitute Decision-maker Act 2024
2024-49.summary: Provides for appointing substitute decision-makers for the use of restrictive practices under Commonwealth aged care law.

2024-50.title: State Taxation Further Amendment Act 2024
2024-50.summary: Updates duty concessions and foreign purchaser duty, and allows first-home grant applications on behalf of beneficiaries of special disability trusts.

2024-51.title: Tobacco Amendment (Tobacco Retailer and Wholesaler Licensing Scheme) Act 2024
2024-51.summary: Introduces tobacco retailer and wholesaler licensing, provides for forfeiture of prohibited products and repeals specified e-cigarette and specialist tobacconist rules.

2025-1.title: Drugs, Poisons and Controlled Substances Amendment (Paramedic Practitioners) Act 2025
2025-1.summary: Establishes paramedic practitioners as a class of registered paramedics and authorises them to handle and supply specified medicines.

2025-2.title: Education and Training Reform Amendment Act 2025
2025-2.summary: Changes registration and enforcement for training providers, non-government schools and boarding premises, and updates work experience and workplace learning rules.

2025-3.title: Statute Law Repeals Act 2025
2025-3.summary: Repeals redundant or spent provisions in Victorian Acts.

2025-4.title: Inquiries Amendment (Yoorrook Justice Commission Records and Other Matters) Act 2025
2025-4.summary: Lets the Yoorrook Justice Commission restrict access to specified records after it ends and updates how records of concluded inquiries are handled.

2025-5.title: Justice Legislation Amendment (Committals) Act 2025
2025-5.summary: Removes the committal test, tightens witnesses’ cross-examination rules and provides for earlier committal for trial in the Supreme Court.

2025-6.title: Consumer and Planning Legislation Amendment (Housing Statement Reform) Act 2025
2025-6.summary: Removes end-of-fixed-term eviction notices, prohibits acceptance of unsolicited rent offers and changes other rental and planning rules.

2025-7.title: Family Violence Protection Amendment Act 2025
2025-7.summary: Corrects defects in specified copies of family violence intervention orders served or purportedly served from 15 November 2024.

2025-8.title: Bail Amendment Act 2025
2025-8.summary: Changes bail tests, emphasises community safety and revises the treatment of children and people accused of offending while on bail.

2025-9.title: Terrorism (Community Protection) and Control of Weapons Amendment Act 2025
2025-9.summary: Updates countering violent extremism arrangements, including multi-agency case management, and amends weapons control law.

2025-10.title: Help to Buy (Commonwealth Powers) Act 2025
2025-10.summary: Adopts parts of the Commonwealth Help to Buy legislation and refers power to amend the shared-equity housing scheme to the Commonwealth Parliament.

2025-11.title: Justice Legislation Amendment (Anti-vilification and Social Cohesion) Act 2025
2025-11.summary: Expands civil protections against vilification and creates serious criminal vilification offences based on protected attributes.

2025-12.title: Safe Patient Care (Nurse to Patient and Midwife to Patient Ratios) Amendment Act 2025
2025-12.summary: Changes staffing calculations and minimum nurse or midwife ratios in specified hospital units, including intensive care, coronary care and emergency departments.

2025-13.title: Energy and Land Legislation Amendment (Energy Safety) Act 2025
2025-13.summary: Updates electricity bushfire mitigation obligations, enforcement powers and penalties, and abolishes two electricity safety advisory committees.

2025-14.title: Regulatory Legislation Amendment (Reform) Act 2025
2025-14.summary: Updates several regulatory schemes, including access to adoption information, authorisation of Aboriginal agency officers and enforcement of circular economy rules.

2025-15.title: Victorian Energy Efficiency Target Amendment (Energy Upgrades for the Future) Act 2025
2025-15.summary: Extends the Victorian Energy Upgrades scheme’s target-setting framework through 2045 and updates rules for eligible activities and participants.

2025-16.title: Fire Services Property Amendment (Emergency Services and Volunteers Fund) Act 2025
2025-16.summary: Broadens the Fire Services Property Levy framework to cover emergency services and volunteers.

2025-17.title: Building Legislation Amendment (Buyer Protections) Act 2025
2025-17.summary: Creates statutory insurance for specified domestic building work and revises protections for buyers of new homes.

2025-18.title: Gambling Legislation Amendment (Pre-commitment and Carded Play) Act 2025
2025-18.summary: Updates gambling pre-commitment and carded play rules and changes gaming machine spin-rate requirements and enforcement.

2025-19.title: Retirement Villages Amendment Act 2025
2025-19.summary: Revises retirement village regulation and consumer protections, including occupation rights, refunds and procedures when residents leave.

2025-20.title: Justice Legislation Amendment (Miscellaneous) Act 2025
2025-20.summary: Amends trustee replacement offences, criminal procedure and sentencing in the Magistrates’ Court, and revises commencement or repeal dates for specified laws.

2025-21.title: Appropriation (2025-2026) Act 2025
2025-21.summary: Authorises spending from the Consolidated Fund for ordinary Victorian Government services in 2025–26.

2025-22.title: Appropriation (Parliament 2025-2026) Act 2025
2025-22.summary: Authorises spending from the Consolidated Fund for the Parliament of Victoria in 2025–26.

2025-23.title: Gambling Legislation Amendment Act 2025
2025-23.summary: Updates gambling monitoring and public lottery licensing and makes related operational changes to gambling and casino legislation.

2025-24.title: State Taxation Acts Amendment Act 2025
2025-24.summary: Changes commercial and industrial property tax and transfer duty rules, including treatment of subdivided land and relief for people affected by family violence.

2025-25.title: Roads and Ports Legislation Amendment (Road Safety and Other Matters) Act 2025
2025-25.summary: Expands who can collect samples for road safety testing and who can enforce certain road offences, and updates traffic fine and ports provisions.

2025-26.title: Transport Legislation Amendment (Vehicle Sharing Scheme Safety and Standards) Act 2025
2025-26.summary: Moves vehicle-sharing scheme regulation into transport compliance legislation and updates electric scooter offences and transitional arrangements.

2025-27.title: Workplace Injury Rehabilitation and Compensation Amendment Act 2025
2025-27.summary: Provides for a workers’ compensation claimants’ code of rights, requires training for return-to-work coordinators and changes support for injured workers and their families.

2025-28.title: Corrections Legislation Amendment Act 2025
2025-28.summary: Revises post-sentence supervision of serious offenders, including order conditions, victim submissions, arrest powers and information sharing.

2025-29.title: Crimes Amendment (Performance Crime) Act 2025
2025-29.summary: Makes it an offence for a person to publish material to draw attention to specified crimes they committed, including carjacking and robbery.

2025-30.title: Financial Management Legislation Amendment Act 2025
2025-30.summary: Removes the requirement for warrants to issue public money and updates Victoria’s financial management and constitutional legislation.

2025-31.title: Local Jobs First Amendment Act 2025
2025-31.summary: Clarifies Local Jobs First procurement obligations for agencies and suppliers and expands the commissioner’s enforcement powers and penalties.

2025-32.title: Superannuation Legislation Amendment Act 2025
2025-32.summary: Changes salary definitions, contributions and board membership under emergency services superannuation law, and updates state superannuation contributions.

2025-33.title: Worker Screening Amendment (Strengthening the Working with Children Check) Act 2025
2025-33.summary: Restricts certain people from child-related work while checks are pending and strengthens powers to suspend or cancel Working with Children clearances.

2025-34.title: Bail Further Amendment Act 2025
2025-34.summary: Tightens bail rules for specified unacceptable risks and alleged offending while on bail, and updates electronic monitoring conditions.

2025-35.title: Wage Theft Amendment Act 2025
2025-35.summary: Repeals Victoria’s wage theft offences, renames the regulator Workforce Inspectorate Victoria and gives it revised functions.

2025-36.title: Domestic Building Contracts Amendment Act 2025
2025-36.summary: Updates domestic building contract requirements, including implied warranties, deposits, cost escalation, variations and progress payments.

2025-37.title: Drugs, Poisons and Controlled Substances Amendment (Medication Administration in Residential Aged Care) Act 2025
2025-37.summary: Revises who may administer specified controlled medicines in residential aged care and aligns Victorian provisions with the new Commonwealth aged care legislation.

2025-38.title: National Electricity (Victoria) Amendment (VicGrid Stage 2 Reform) Act 2025
2025-38.summary: Updates the governance and functions of VicGrid as a statutory body and transfers to it powers previously held by its chief executive.

2025-39.title: Australian Grands Prix Amendment Act 2025
2025-39.summary: Extends the permitted Grand Prix race period, updates insignia and payment rules, and allows the event corporation to host approved non-motorsport events.

2025-40.title: Casino and Gambling Legislation Amendment Act 2025
2025-40.summary: Changes casino oversight, disciplinary powers, player activity statements, cashless and carded play, and club gaming machine entitlements.

2025-41.title: Statute Law Revision Act 2025
2025-41.summary: Makes technical corrections and updates statutory references to reflect administrative arrangements.

2025-42.title: Domestic Animals Amendment (Rehoming Cats and Dogs and Other Matters) Act 2025
2025-42.summary: Creates a voluntary authorisation scheme for pet rehoming organisations and improves council notification and reporting on fostered or rehomed dogs and cats.

2025-43.title: Building Legislation Amendment (Fairer Payments on Jobsites and Other Matters) Act 2025
2025-43.summary: Reforms construction payment and performance security claims and the process for adjudicating disputes over them, and addresses unfair contract terms.

2025-44.title: Mental Health Legislation Amendment Act 2025
2025-44.summary: Updates mental health tribunal and information-sharing rules, abolishes the Forensic Leave Panel and gives specified forensic functions to the Mental Health Tribunal.

2025-45.title: Statewide Treaty Act 2025
2025-45.summary: Gives effect to the Statewide Treaty, establishes Gellung Warl and provides for First Peoples’ representation, consultation, accountability and truth-telling.

2025-46.title: Consumer Legislation Amendment Act 2025
2025-46.summary: Allows rental bond transfers, changes evidence requirements for bond claims, broadens fee prohibitions and updates gas and electrical safety checks.

2025-47.title: Parks and Public Land Legislation Amendment (Central West and Other Matters) Act 2025
2025-47.summary: Changes the designation and management of specified public land, including creating Wandong Regional Park and altering land at Princes Park and Bendigo Regional Park.

2025-48.title: State Taxation Further Amendment Act 2025
2025-48.summary: Changes entry into the commercial and industrial property tax scheme and revises the parking congestion levy, including its rates and residential parking exemption.

2025-49.title: Victorian Early Childhood Regulatory Authority Act 2025
2025-49.summary: Establishes the Victorian Early Childhood Regulatory Authority and provides for a register of early childhood workers.

2025-50.title: Voluntary Assisted Dying Amendment Act 2025
2025-50.summary: Changes voluntary assisted dying eligibility, including the expected time to death, and revises assessment, objection and access procedures.

2025-51.title: Restricting Non-disclosure Agreements (Sexual Harassment at Work) Act 2025
2025-51.summary: Restricts when non-disclosure agreements concerning workplace sexual harassment may be made, what they may contain and when they can be enforced.

2025-52.title: Crimes Amendment (Retail, Fast Food, Hospitality and Transport Worker Harm) Act 2025
2025-52.summary: Creates an offence of assaulting or threatening specified frontline workers and treats burglary involving a ram raid as aggravated burglary.

2025-53.title: Early Childhood Legislation Amendment (Child Safety) Act 2025
2025-53.summary: Expands child safety information sharing, changes time limits for prosecutions and increases maximum penalties under the national education and care law.

2025-54.title: Justice Legislation Amendment (Community Safety) Act 2025
2025-54.summary: Increases penalties for specified offences, criminalises knife use in specified indictable offences and expands carjacking to cover vehicle theft with a child under 10 inside.

2025-55.title: Justice Legislation Amendment (Police and Other Matters) Act 2025
2025-55.summary: Changes unexplained wealth and weapons search area provisions and permits audiovisual appearances for specified applications involving samples or physical examinations.

2025-56.title: Transport Legislation Amendment Act 2025
2025-56.summary: Changes bus accreditation requirements and requires specified booking services and commercial passenger vehicle drivers to report information to the regulator.

2025-57.title: Labour Hire Legislation Amendment (Licensing) Act 2025
2025-57.summary: Revises labour hire licensing coverage and fitness requirements and expands the regulator’s monitoring, enforcement and information-sharing powers.

2025-58.title: Social Services Regulation Amendment (Child Safety, Complaints and Worker Regulation) Act 2025
2025-58.summary: Transfers child safety standards and reportable conduct functions to the Social Services Regulator and changes complaints and worker regulation.

2026-1.title: Justice Legislation Amendment (Family Violence, Stalking and Other Matters) Act 2026
2026-1.summary: Changes family violence and stalking intervention order procedures, including service and duration, and requires consideration of possible misidentification in family violence cases.

2026-2.title: Mineral Resources (Sustainable Development) Amendment (Financial Assurance) Act 2026
2026-2.summary: Makes specified former mine operators or related parties liable for rehabilitation in certain circumstances and updates rehabilitation plans and change-of-control notices.

2026-3.title: Planning Amendment (Better Decisions Made Faster) Act 2026
2026-3.summary: Overhauls planning objectives, strategies and procedures for preparing and amending planning schemes, including the roles of councils and the Minister.

2026-4.title: Health Safeguards for People Born with Variations in Sex Characteristics Act 2026
2026-4.summary: Creates consent and approval safeguards for specified medical treatment of people with innate variations in sex characteristics, and prohibits treatment in certain circumstances.

2026-5.title: Justice Legislation Amendment (Vicarious Liability for Child Abuse) Act 2026
2026-5.summary: Changes organisations’ vicarious liability for child abuse, including historical abuse, and provides for specified settlements or judgments to be set aside.

2026-6.title: Children, Youth and Families Amendment (Stability) Act 2026
2026-6.summary: Changes the duration and extension of family reunification orders, removes adoption from the case-planning hierarchy and adds stability to the best-interests principles.

2026-7.title: Children, Youth and Families Amendment (Supporting Stable and Strong Families) Act 2026
2026-7.summary: Assigns responsibilities to partner agencies for supporting stable and strong families and expands the Children’s Services Co-ordination Board’s role.

2026-8.title: Crimes Amendment Act 2026
2026-8.summary: Limits prosecution of specified criminal vilification offences to police or the Director of Public Prosecutions and requires the Director’s consent for prosecution of a person under 18.

2026-9.title: Energy and Other Legislation Amendment (Resilience Reforms and Other Matters) Act 2026
2026-9.summary: Requires electricity distributors to prepare network resilience plans, updates retailer obligations to life-support customers and changes easement acquisition rules.

2026-10.title: National Gas (Victoria) Amendment Act 2026
2026-10.summary: Allows ministerial orders to expedite increases in gas transmission capacity and supports upgrades to Victoria’s declared transmission systems.

2026-11.title: Entities Legislation Amendment (Consolidation and Other Matters) Act 2026
2026-11.summary: Transfers specified Recycling Victoria functions to the Environment Protection Authority and abolishes the Victorian Environmental Assessment Council and Marine and Coastal Council.

2026-12.title: Education and Training Reform Amendment (Free TAFE Guarantee) Act 2026
2026-12.summary: Guarantees specified tuition-free TAFE courses and provides for a TAFE funding guarantee and network planning framework.

2026-13.title: Electoral Amendment Act 2026
2026-13.summary: Changes electoral procedures, including supplementary elections, re-elections, party registration and authorisation of electoral advertising and material.

2026-14.title: Justice Legislation Further Amendment (Miscellaneous) Act 2026
2026-14.summary: Changes powers to vary or revoke court orders, streamlines the closing and reopening of coronial investigations and expands which doctors may register deaths.

2026-15.title: Regulatory Legislation Amendment (Reform) Act 2026
2026-15.summary: Makes operational and technical changes across regulatory laws, including waste reporting, recycling infrastructure plans, environmental licences and gas-sector reporting.

2026-16.title: Safe Food Victoria Act 2026
2026-16.summary: Creates Safe Food Victoria, replaces Dairy Food Safety Victoria and PrimeSafe, and extends regulation to novel foods and production technologies.

2026-17.title: Building and Plumbing Administration and Enforcement Act 2026
2026-17.summary: Recasts building and plumbing regulation and enforcement, establishes the Building and Plumbing Commission and updates practitioner discipline.

2026-18.title: Cladding Safety Victoria Repeal Act 2026
2026-18.summary: Abolishes Cladding Safety Victoria, transfers its property, rights and liabilities to the Victorian Building Authority and revises the building permit levy for non-regional buildings.

2026-19.title: Electoral Further Amendment Act 2026
2026-19.summary: Revises political donation disclosure, reporting and public funding rules, including a higher general donation cap for new entrants.

2026-20.title: Appropriation (2026-2027) Act 2026
2026-20.summary: Authorises spending from the Consolidated Fund for ordinary Victorian Government services in 2026–27.

2026-21.title: Appropriation (Parliament 2026-2027) Act 2026
2026-21.summary: Authorises spending from the Consolidated Fund for the Parliament of Victoria in 2026–27.

2026-22.title: Building Legislation and Treasury Legislation (Tax Relief) Amendment Act 2026
2026-22.summary: Changes building orders, insurance and construction payment adjudication, and revises duty concessions for new dwellings and specified land tax rules.

2026-23.title: Victoria Police Amendment (Police Reservists) Act 2026
2026-23.summary: Updates eligibility and appointment rules for police reservists and sets out their duties, oath and resignation arrangements.

2026-24.title: Dangerous Goods Transport Act 2026
2026-24.summary: Establishes a framework for transporting dangerous goods by road, rail and inland waterways and repeals the Dangerous Goods Act 1985.

2026-25.title: Education and Training Reform Amendment Act 2026
2026-25.summary: Strengthens Aboriginal recognition and self-determination across education and training, and changes registration, information-sharing and interim suspension rules.

2026-26.title: Health Legislation Amendment (Regulatory Reform) Act 2026
2026-26.summary: Introduces accreditation requirements for assisted reproductive treatment providers, expands registration and inspection powers and updates non-emergency patient transport regulation.

2026-27.title: Occupational Health and Safety Amendment (Dangerous Goods) Act 2026
2026-27.summary: Brings dangerous goods handling at workplaces and other places within occupational health and safety law.

2026-28.title: Electoral Amendment (Miscellaneous Matters) Act 2026
2026-28.summary: Abolishes group voting tickets for Legislative Council elections and updates rules for above-the-line and below-the-line voting.

2026-29.title: Firearms Amendment Act 2026
2026-29.summary: Continues the firearm prohibition order scheme, changes firearm categories, introduces citizenship and background-check requirements for licensing, and increases specified penalties.

2026-30.title: Fishing, Hunting and Outdoor Victoria Act 2026
2026-30.summary: Establishes Fishing, Hunting and Outdoor Victoria and the Land and Aquatic Access Panel, and repeals the laws establishing the former game and fisheries regulators.

2026-31.title: Corrections Amendment Act 2026
2026-31.summary: Makes prisoners’ access to open air subject to operational considerations, revises police gaol detention provisions and validates specified past actions.

2026-32.title: Crimes Amendment (Recruitment of Children for Criminal Activity and Production Notices) Act 2026
2026-32.summary: Creates a further offence of recruiting children for criminal activity and establishes a process for requiring financial institutions to produce documents.

2026-33.title: Racing Legislation Amendment (Entity Governance and Other Matters) Act 2026
2026-33.summary: Provides for recognised governing bodies for harness and greyhound racing and restructures racing integrity arrangements.

2026-34.title: Safe Patient Care (Nurse to Patient and Midwife to Patient Ratios) Amendment Act 2026
2026-34.summary: Assigns or changes specified hospitals’ categories for the purpose of minimum nurse-to-patient and midwife-to-patient ratios.

2026-35.title: Workplace Protection Orders Act 2026
2026-35.summary: Enables the Magistrates’ Court and Children’s Court to make orders restricting unacceptable conduct connected to specified workplaces.

2026-36.title: Consumer Legislation Amendment Act 2026
2026-36.summary: Updates consumer enforcement rules for seized property and debt collection, and provides for licence suspension where conveyancers fail specified trust account audit requirements.

2026-37.title: Energy and Resources Legislation Amendment (VEET Strategic Review and Other Matters) Act 2026
2026-37.summary: Revises the Victorian Energy Upgrades framework, including accreditation and the range of activities eligible for energy efficiency certificates.

2026-38.title: Education and Training Reform Amendment (Apprenticeships, Traineeships, Schools and Other Matters) Act 2026
2026-38.summary: Creates a new apprenticeship and traineeship regulatory and licensing scheme and transfers specified functions to Workforce Inspectorate Victoria.

2026-39.title: Fair Work (Commonwealth Powers) Amendment Act 2026
2026-39.summary: Changes Victoria’s referral of workplace relations powers to the Commonwealth, including enterprise bargaining rules for specified public sector employees and provisions affecting law enforcement officers.

2026-40.title: Multicultural Victoria Amendment (Multicultural and Multifaith Victoria) Act 2026
2026-40.summary: Establishes Multicultural and Multifaith Victoria and provides for community and regional advisory groups, revised multicultural principles and reporting.

2026-41.title: Justice Legislation Amendment (Family Violence, Coercive Control, Good Character, Risk Assessment and Other Matters) Act 2026
2026-41.summary: Enables extension or variation of family violence intervention orders in criminal proceedings and changes information sharing, risk assessment and sentencing rules on good character.

2026-42.title: Local Government Legislation Amendment (Stronger Communities) Act 2026
2026-42.summary: Strengthens council governance and integrity requirements and enables a local government Fair Jobs Code and regulator.

2026-43.title: Independent Broad-based Anti-corruption Commission Amendment Act 2026
2026-43.summary: Broadens the definition of corrupt conduct and expands the anti-corruption commission’s powers to trace financial dealings.

2026-44.title: Inquiries Amendment (Special Prosecutor) Act 2026
2026-44.summary: Creates a Special Prosecutor to assist the Construction Royal Commission and strengthens royal commissions’ information-gathering powers.

2026-45.title: Workplace Legislation Amendment (Accident Compensation and Other Matters) Act 2026
2026-45.summary: Updates workplace reckless endangerment offences, accident compensation rules for supported accommodation and damages claims for specified dust-related conditions.
